## Course Description
The full data-pipeline lifecycle — ingestion, modeling, transformation, and
operating an ELT system in production.

## Schedule
| Wk | Topic | Reading | Lab |
|----|-------|---------|-----|
| 1 | The modern data stack | Reis & Housley Ch. 1–2 | Environment setup |
| 2 | Ingestion: batch vs. streaming | Kleppmann Ch. 11 | Ingest an API feed |
| 3 | Dimensional modeling | Kimball Ch. 3 | Design a schema |
| 4 | Transformation with dbt | dbt docs | First dbt model |
| ... | | | |

## Grading
- 4 labs (8% each) = 32%
- midterm = 18%
- final project = 35%
- participation & quizzes = 15%
